verdict.rationale: Bolt supports exporting a project to GitHub (create/import repos, sync commits) which lets a developer take the generated code and deploy it to any external host or infrastructure of their choosing, and it supports attaching a custom domain to a project. However, Bolt's own docs emphasize deployment through its own Cloud/hosting and domain-purchase flow rather than a documented one-click deploy to arbitrary external hosts (AWS, own servers, etc.), and one community report describes Bolt itself pushing to third-party hosts (Netlify/Vercel) without disclosure, muddying the 'developer-controlled' deploy story. missing for 10: explicit first-party support/docs for deploying to arbitrary external infrastructure (not just GitHub export + custom domain), and independent confirmation that exported code deploys cleanly elsewhere.
